techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
techniques.description: Adversaries may aggressively guess passwords for a specific target account to achieve authentication access.

techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
techniques.description: Adversaries may use a single or small set of common passwords against many different user accounts to acquire valid credentials while evading account-lockout thresholds.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.tactic: Initial Access / Persistence / Privilege Escalation / Defense Evasion
techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, or Defense Evasion.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts: Default Accounts
techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse default accounts (such as admin or guest) that are pre-configured on devices or applications.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts: Local Accounts
techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of local computer accounts such as local root or Administrator.

techniques.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
techniques.description: Adversaries may exploit software vulnerabilities or configuration flaws in elevated permissions mechanisms like sudo or Windows token assignments.

techniques.name: Endpoint Denial of Service
techniques.description: Adversaries may cause service degradation or account lockouts through excessive high-frequency authentication attempts.
